topic: Analytics dashboard testing and data logic
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on technical issues within the analytics platform. [me] explained that a 'dummy' value is used to prevent footfall metrics from dropping when unique user counts are low. The calculation for footfall relies on `clusterFrequency`, which can lead to an artificially high number, causing footfall (calculated as `session_predicted`/`clusterFrequency`) to approach zero. The dummy mechanism takes the greater of either footfall or uniques values.

[p1] mentioned that they had already explained this logic and planned to test a new report and updated dwell times after a meeting. [me] subsequently deployed a mixed version of the dashboard to the dev environment for testing.
decisions: A mixed version of the analytics dashboard was deployed to the dev environment.
action_items: [p1] will review the new report and dwell times today, and discuss them in the evening.
